title: Minneapolis Trivia Night

questions.q: Minneapolis and which neighboring city together make up the Twin Cities?
Which waterfall on the Mississippi River powered the flour mills that earned Minneapolis the name Mill City?
The Minneapolis Sculpture Garden's best-known work is a giant spoon holding what?
Which 1984 film starring Prince was shot largely in Minneapolis?
What name is given to the Minneapolis burger with melted cheese sealed inside the patty?
In the opening credits of which 1970s sitcom does the star toss her hat in the air on a downtown Minneapolis street?
Which NBA franchise played in Minneapolis before moving to Los Angeles in 1960?
Downtown's network of enclosed, second-story pedestrian bridges between buildings is known as what?
Minnehaha Falls was made famous by which Henry Wadsworth Longfellow poem?
Since moving to Minnesota in 1961, the Twins have won the World Series in 1987 and which other year?

notes: Minneapolis and Saint Paul are the Twin Cities; see Minneapolis-Saint Paul (Wikipedia).
Saint Anthony Falls powered the mills that made Minneapolis the flour milling capital, hence Mill City; see Saint Anthony Falls (Wikipedia).
Spoonbridge and Cherry (1988) by Claes Oldenburg and Coosje van Bruggen; see Spoonbridge and Cherry (Wikipedia) or Walker Art Center.
Purple Rain (1984) filmed largely in Minneapolis; see Purple Rain (film) (Wikipedia).
Cheese-stuffed burger claimed by Minneapolis; both spellings in use; see Juicy Lucy (Wikipedia).
The Mary Tyler Moore Show (CBS, 1970-1977) was set in Minneapolis; the hat toss was filmed on Nicollet Mall; see The Mary Tyler Moore Show (Wikipedia).
Minneapolis Lakers moved to Los Angeles in 1960; see History of the Minneapolis Lakers (Wikipedia).
Minneapolis Skyway System, enclosed second-level walkways; see Minneapolis Skyway System (Wikipedia).
Longfellow's The Song of Hiawatha (1855) named Minnehaha and made the falls famous; see Minnehaha Falls (Wikipedia).
1991; the 1924 title was won as the Washington Senators, which 'since moving' excludes.
